verdict.rationale: Bun documents automatic conversion when `bun install` runs in a project without `bun.lock`: it migrates `yarn.lock` (v1), `package-lock.json` (lockfileVersion 2–4) and `pnpm-lock.yaml`. It also honors npm `overrides` and Yarn `resolutions`, uses npm-style workspaces, can still write a Yarn lockfile alongside its own, and works as a standalone package manager in existing Node.js projects. A community user reports the switching cost was effectively zero. missing for 10: migration of Yarn Berry (v2+) lockfiles, a step-by-step migration guide beyond the lockfile note, and independent confirmation that lockfile migration is reliable (one user hit Windows install crashes possibly tied to an old package-lock and had to delete lockfiles).
